name: Bela Vista Hotel & Spa
insider_take: This clifftop sanctuary overlooking Praia da Rocha is where Portuguese royalty once retreated – and it still feels like a royal escape.
whats_special: Built in 1916 as a summer residence for wealthy families, Bela Vista sits dramatically perched on red sandstone cliffs above one of the Algarve's most stunning beaches. The hotel's Moorish-inspired architecture and terraced gardens create an intimate oasis, while the Vista restaurant holds a Michelin star for its innovative Portuguese cuisine featuring the day's fresh catch from local fishermen.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner on the terrace during summer months – the view of the Atlantic paired with the restaurant's signature cataplana is unforgettable, and you'll often spot dolphins playing in the waves below.
dont_miss: Take the private clifftop path down to Praia da Rocha's golden sands, or venture 10 minutes to Portimão's historic sardine canning district, now transformed into a vibrant waterfront with authentic tascas serving the region's famous grilled sardines and vinho verde.
pros: Spectacular clifftop location overlooking Praia da Rocha beach
Luxurious spa with comprehensive wellness treatments
Elegant Belle Époque architecture and sophisticated design
cons: Limited family amenities - more suited for couples
